note: One layer removed from the primary source, and knowingly so. IANA's media types
registry is the authority, but it is published at unversioned URLs that change in
place -- there is nothing to pin an integrity hash to, so an adapter reading it
directly could not tell a legitimate registry update from a compromised response.
mime-db is the reconciliation of the IANA registry with Apache's and nginx's mapping
files, published as immutable npm releases. Taking it means trusting one
intermediary in exchange for a supply chain that can actually be verified. Revisit
if IANA ever publishes versioned snapshots.
